description: In front of you is a gray fridge cabinet next to a toy oven, with several toy foods inside and then spread out on the floor in front. The left hand reaches forward to pull the fridge door open and holds it as a left-hand object, while the right hand repeatedly reaches into the lower shelf to grasp and pull out items—first a loaf-shaped bread, then a small yellow piece, then a green fruit and a red fruit—placing them on the floor; the right hand then lifts the burger from the upper shelf and sets it down, grabs the banana and sets it down too, and finally the left hand swings the door shut and releases it.
